name: Depth Prepass with Equal-Depth Shading
definition: Optimizes rendering of overlapping opaque spheres by ensuring shading and ray tracing run only for the nearest sphere per pixel, bypassing the loss of GPU hidden-surface removal caused by discard-based impostors.
summary: Depth Prepass with Equal-Depth Shading optimizes overlapping opaque primitives by using a dedicated depth prepass and an equal-depth comparison to ensure only the nearest primitive is shaded, bypassing GPU hidden-surface removal failures caused by discard-based impostors.
